summary: LCI Industries filed an 8-K on October 13, 2026, disclosing that on October 9, 2026, it and Patrick Industries each received a Second Request from the DOJ regarding their pending merger. Under the June 30, 2026, Merger Agreement, First Merger Sub will merge into LCI, surviving as a Patrick subsidiary, then merge into Second Merger Sub. The parties withdrew their initial HSR filings on September 4, 2026, refiled September 9, 2026, and now face an extended waiting period until 30 days after substantial compliance with the Second Request.
